sources.entry: Easy Share Uploader - Allows users to easily host their local images to the internet through multiple services and available on App Store.

summary.one_liner: Easy Share Uploader is a macOS application for uploading local images to the internet through multiple hosting services.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and describes it as a Mac OS X application that lets users host local images online via several services. It is listed in a macOS apps collection under sharing files. The README names no specific upload services, no settings, and no build or install steps. The listing notes it is available on the App Store, which comes from the collection description rather than the README itself.
use_cases: upload local images to the internet
host pictures online from a Mac
notable: Uploads local images to multiple hosting services
Listed as available on the App Store (per the collection listing)
caveats: README is minimal; no details on supported services, features, or setup
